title: PaymentMandate
description: Final authorization to move funds against a specific locked CartMandate.

payment_id.description: Unique identifier for this payment mandate.

cart_id.description: Reference to the CartMandate.cart_id being paid for.

intent_reference.description: intent_id of the originating IntentMandate, carried through for auditability.

final_paise.description: Final authorized payment amount, in paise. Should equal the cart's total_paise.
